name: Silver Harper Pin

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond item page in signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/11054399-silver-harper-pin. Prices use the existing rarity convention; unspecified weight is 0. Reference-only properties require manual adjudication.

summary: Reference-only: when attuning, choose a Harper persona, including its alignment and creature type.
text: Reference-only: when attuning, choose a Harper persona, including its alignment and creature type. While worn, magic identifying your type, alignment, or location reports that persona. Also set a thought of up to 25 words at attunement; thought-reading detects that preset message. A reader can use Study and DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation) to recognize that the thoughts are preprogrammed.
